Sandbox_DeadMansDossier_DropChance_Polic: Chance that a police zombie drops a dossier page when killed. Police dossier requires 2 pages to assemble. Rewards: pistols, shotguns, ammo, police gear.
Sandbox_DeadMansDossier_DropChance_Milit: Chance that a military zombie drops a dossier page when killed. Military dossier requires 3 pages to assemble. Rewards: assault rifles, ammo, camo gear, military backpack.
Sandbox_DeadMansDossier_DropChance_Medic: Chance that a doctor or nurse zombie drops a dossier page when killed. Medical dossier requires 2 pages to assemble. Rewards: antibiotics, bandages, painkillers, surgical tools.
Sandbox_DeadMansDossier_DropChance_Firef: Chance that a firefighter zombie drops a dossier page when killed. Firefighter dossier requires 2 pages to assemble. Rewards: axe, sledgehammer, crowbar, fireman gear, blow torch.
Sandbox_DeadMansDossier_DropChance_Range: Chance that a ranger zombie drops a dossier page when killed. Ranger dossier requires 2 pages to assemble. Rewards: hunting rifle, shotguns, knife, hatchet, ranger gear.
Sandbox_DeadMansDossier_ContainerSpawnRa: How often dossier pages spawn inside world containers (police lockers, military storage, hospital cabinets, fire dept lockers). This is separate from zombie drops.
Sandbox_DeadMansDossier_RewardRarity_too: Multiplier applied to all stash reward drop chances. Generous doubles the chances, Minimal makes only the most common items drop.
Sandbox_DeadMansDossier_ProximityRadius_: How close (in tiles) you must be to a stash location to collect the reward (5-50). Default: 15 tiles. Lower = harder to find, higher = easier. Players get color-coded proximity hints as they approach.
Sandbox_DeadMansDossier_UseCustomRewards: When enabled, stash rewards are loaded from the config file at Zomboid/Lua/DeadMansDossier_Rewards.cfg instead of using the built-in reward tables. The config file is auto-generated with defaults on first server start. Edit it to add, remove, or change reward items and their drop chances. The Reward Rarity multiplier still applies on top.
